sources.note: Secondhand tone statement in the literature review (sec. 2.3, citing Person 2007): syllable C1(C2)VT(C3) with obligatory tone; three contrastive tones low, mid, high. Also notes the Lahu-based trial orthography has trouble marking tone because Pyen keeps final consonants (p.18). Appendix A (pp.124-165) gives Pyen (two villages), Laomian and Laopin wordlists in IPA with Chao tone numbers (21 / 33 / 35). Tones are explicitly ignored in the lexicostatistic comparison.
